notes.title: Mac Update + General news
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I want to thank you all for playing my game and leaving your reviews. Negative or positive, they are very helpful and have [b]all[/b] been taken into consideration.

My first note of update is the addition of the Mac version. Steam has made it a little tricky to upload multiple OS versions so I have tried my best to present a Mac version. Should you come across any issues (Mac Users) please let me know immediately and I will have it fixed.

The second major news is that I have gone back to improve several scenes and add what was removed. For those who have played the previous version of my game, you will note that I was forced to remove a number of scenes due to copyright issues. 

I am currently working on a large storyline for each of the individual endings. They will be available all at once. Stay tuned for more updates.

Thank you.
